cluster_recommendation: The canonical map is coherent and already documented in three places (open-design's own 'Recommended Pipeline', SKILL-DIRECTORY.md:730, skill-router routing-table.md): open-design owns 'design a UI from scratch' as the brand-constrained production pipeline (verified 138 design-systems dirs, matching its own SKILL.md claim — SKILL-DIRECTORY.md and agentbox.toml both carry the stale '129' instead); ui-ux-pro-max-skill is explicitly subordinate to it as a discovery/inspiration database (palettes/fonts/styles), not a competing entry point; bencium-creative owns the downstream bold/anti-slop shadcn+Tailwind+Phosphor build step; design-audit uncontested owns post-build audit/polish; daisyui uncontested owns the Tailwind component-library layer but is the one design skill with zero references/ and Claude-CLI-only MCP setup instructions, needing a progressive-disclosure pass and a Codex-compatible fallback. The earlier bencium-innovative-ux-designer + bencium-impact-designer -> bencium-creative consolidation was executed correctly (clean deprecated-stub format, matches the SKILL-DIRECTORY deprecated table) and both stubs should stay as redirects, not be deleted — they cost nothing extra against the skill-count gate either way and a redirect beats a silent invocation failure. The remaining bencium-* skills are not actually redundant with each other (bencium-creative = bold anti-slop direction, bencium-controlled-ux-designer = WCAG/enterprise, bencium-aeo = AI-search optimisation, out of scope here) except bencium-code-conventions, which is qualitatively different: a named individual's personal machine/workflow preferences (Mac M2, no Docker/CUDA, Tailwind v3-never-v4) presented as a generally-invocable estate skill, with no trace of that individual anywhere in this workspace's own CLAUDE.md tiers, and a direct version-pin contradiction against daisyui and leptos (both current on Tailwind v4). Recommend scoping it to Bence's actual project rather than the shared master estate, or making the person/project binding explicit in the description. renaissance-architecture and relationship-design both function correctly as 'philosophy' skills and are NOT isolated in the cross-reference graph, but only relationship-design carries an explicit When-NOT-to-use guard; renaissance-architecture's broad 'designing/architecting/reviewing a design' trigger has no such guard and risks over-matching ordinary work. leptos and wasm-js are both high-quality, well-referenced, rot-free skills, but only wasm-js is correctly positioned relative to rust-development (bidirectional cross-links, reference-only tier); leptos has a genuine name!=dir bug, zero inbound cross-references, is missing from routing-table.md, and — most notably — occupies one of only 22 always-loaded registration slots despite being narrower in scope than rust-development, which the estate deliberately keeps reference-only. Also found: a real numeric contradiction between ui-ux-pro-max-skill (line-height 1.5-1.75) and typography/batch-04 (line-height 1.2-1.45) with zero overlap, needing reconciliation with the typography auditor.
